title: Why evangelicals who are unconcerned say climate change is not serious
subtitle: All U.S. evangelical Protestants, 2022
caption: Thirty-eight percent of evangelicals said climate change is not too serious or not a problem. Asked why, the most common answers were that the world has bigger problems and that God is in control of the climate; fewer said they doubt it is happening at all.
note: Asked only of those who said climate change is not too serious a problem or not a problem; respondents could pick more than one reason. Pew reports each figure as a share of all evangelical Protestants surveyed, not only of the 38%. The colors are our grouping, not Pew's.
